description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Dq, which manages parse trees for double-quoted strings within templates in the Smarty template engine. It provides methods for constructing, appending to, and merging string parse trees during template parsing.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Dq
classes.description: Handles parse trees for double quoted strings within Smarty templates, supporting construction, appending, and merging of string segments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parse tree buffer for a double-quoted string subtree, adjusting parser state if the subtree is a tag.

methods.name: append_subtree
methods.description: Appends a subtree to the current parse tree buffer, handling different subtree types and updating parser state.

methods.name: to_smarty_php
methods.description: Merges and compiles the subtree buffer content into PHP code for template rendering.
